notes.title: Commandos: Origins - A triumphant return
notes.content:
[h1]The Commandos series returns in 2024 with Commandos: Origins[/h1]

A new story from the classic real-time stealth tactics series is now in development

We are thrilled to announce that [b]Commandos, the iconic real-time stealth tactics game series, is making a triumphant return[/b] with "Commandos: Origins" in [b]2024[/b].

[previewyoutube=XHA9IAN3ZX8;full][/previewyoutube]

Commandos: Origins takes players back to World War II, where you can [b]see the original characters unite to form the legendary Commandos squad[/b]. Engage in close-quarters-combat with The Green Beret, Jack O’Hara, and take down Nazi soldiers with brutal strength and efficiency, or obliterate key tactical targets with The Sapper, a fearless firefighter turned demolitions expert.

A gripping storyline sets the stage for a thrilling adventure, filled with challenging missions and tactical stealth gameplay. With [b]over 10 missions across authentic historical locations[/b], spanning the icy landscapes of the Arctic to the scorching sands of the African desert, you'll find yourself facing varied scenarios and diverse objectives. Each mission offers a fresh and engaging experience that keeps players eagerly anticipating each new challenge.

The game offers an exhilarating and challenging real-time strategy gameplay experience allowing you to harness the unique abilities of the Commandos, master the art of stealth, to strike from the shadows, and vanish into the night before the enemy can react.

[b]Commandos: Origins is gearing up for a 2024 release[/b] and will be available on day one on Xbox Game Pass for console and PC and on Xbox Series X|S, Windows PC, and PlayStation 5.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479730/Commandos_Origins/

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Challenging Real Time Tactical Stealth Gameplay:[/b] Make the best use of your Commandos’ unique abilities, infiltrate enemy facilities and hit them where it hurts most before disappearing into the shadows.
[*] [b]An extraordinary team:[/b] Featuring 6 infamous characters, each with their own storied history, banding together to form an extraordinary fighting force – the Commandos: Take control over Jack O’Hara “the Green Beret”, Thomas “the Sapper” Hancock, Francis T. “the Sniper” Woolridge, Samuel “the Driver” Brooklyn, James “the Marine” Blackwood, and Rene “the Spy” Duchamp and lead them to success. 
[*][b] Many paths to victory:[/b] The detailed, varied and interactive environments offer multiple approaches to reach your goal. Sneak, climb, drive in various vehicles, or hide and creep your way to mission success!
[*] [b]On your mark:[/b] A modern user experience with precise and intuitive controls enables you to control the commandos with expert precision. Coordinate complex actions simultaneously to overcome heavily fortified targets.
[*] [b]Fight on all fronts:[/b] Play through more than 10 missions in historically authentic WWII environments, spanning from the barren Arctic to the African desert, with a range of core and voluntary objectives that will require your full tactical expertise.
[*] [b]There is no I in team:[/b] Take on missions with a friend in the 2-player cooperative multiplayer mode, either online or via local split-screen.[/list]

notes.title: Commandos 2 & 3 – HD Remaster Retail Double Pack Out Now
notes.content:
[h1]Commandos 2 & 3 – HD Remaster Retail Double Pack Out Now[/h1]

Now in retail stores, the Commandos Double Pack offers players the chance to enjoy both HD Remasters of Commandos 2 and 3. Take history into your own hands as you lead your elite unit of Allied commandos onto the battlefields of World War II Europe. With the Green Beret, Sapper, Sniper, Diver, Spy and Thief awaiting your command, your covert actions will be of the utmost importance as you venture deep behind enemy lines. Take on more than 20 perilous missions across the two cult classics where your tactics will be put to the ultimate test. Experiment with daring strategy, employ authentic weaponry and utilise interactive environments as you crawl, swing, swim and climb to victory. Mission accepted?  

Time to rally your recruits for the Commandos 2 & 3 HD Double Pack which is now available in stores on Xbox One, PlayStation 4, [b]PC (Steam at Retail)[/b] and Nintendo Switch™ (Retail version only available on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in North America).  

Fall in and ambush the trailer below. 
https://youtu.be/voAPrCXWb4E

[h2]Features [/h2]
[list][*] Control unique daredevil commandos: each with different skills and specializations including green beret, sniper, demolition expert, diver and thief. 
[*] Experience authentic WWII scenarios: there are more than 20 missions across the two games!  
[*] The choice is yours: how you tackle each mission is up to you. Experiment with skills and weapons in a challenging “against the odds” gameplay style. 
[*] WWII vehicles and weapons: including jeeps, tanks, trucks, ships, bazookas and flame-throwers.  
[*] Interactive environments: steal enemy uniforms and weapons, climb poles, swing from cables, swim, utilize vehicles, and climb in/out of buildings, ships and planes. 
[*] Remastered in high definition: includes reworked 3D models and textures built from the ground up, improved controls, refined UI and beginner-friendly tutorials and hints. 
[*] Rally your troops for multiplayer in Commandos 3 – HD Remaster: you can compete in ‘Deathmatch’ or ‘Collect the Flag’ modes, all with distinct victory conditions. 
[/list]

notes.title: Commandos 3 - HD Remaster Update
notes.content:
[h1]Commandos 3 - HD Remaster Update Changelog [/h1]

 
[i]Commandos! [/i]

[b]Commandos 3 – HD Remaster[/b] has received an [b]Update [/b]for [b]PC, Xbox One, PlayStation[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch™[/b].  
The Update includes several bug fixes e.g., the game no longer crashing in the "Get to the Engine" mission and the "It’s Nap Time" achievement now being triggered correctly.  

Thank you very much for all your support! 
[i]Your Commandos 3 – HD Remaster Team [/i]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2] 
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the player could select "Ready" in a CO-OP Multiplayer game lobby before loading the information of other players who were already in the lobby. 
[*]Fixed an issue in which machine gun forced fire was not executed correctly. 
[*]Fixed an issue where some actions were triggered unnecessarily when the loading screen was skipped. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the "Save Complete" message was not displayed after manually saving from the pause menu. 
[*]Fixed crashes with the ‘Get To The Engine’ mission. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the "It’s Nap Time" achievement could not be unlocked. 
[*][b][PC only][/b] It is now possible to aim and shoot at enemies using the CTRL key as in the original game. 
[*][b][PC only][/b] Pressing the right mouse button while holding down the CTRL key in cover mode now correctly rotates the commando towards the cursor position.[/list]
[h2]Microsoft Store PC only[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed a crash related to key mapping. 
[*]Fixed some issues related to saving and loading. 
[*]Music is now correctly looping in the main menu. 
[*]Fixed various text- and localization errors. 
[*]Fixed an issue where it was not possible to throw enemy bodies into the water with a controller. 
[*]Fixed an issue where it was not possible to shoot at the dog using a controller. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the camera went unresponsive while underwater in the mission ‘Destroy the Warships’. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the sniper lens effect was not properly visible. 
[*]Fixed an issue where it was randomly possible to see the explosion visual effect indoors. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the player was stuck in cover mode after switching between M+K and controller UI while cover mode was active. 
[*]Fixed an issue where it was not possible to throw enemy corpses into the hole of the sewer. 
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur by using the grappling hook in multiplayer play. 
[*]Fixed some issues with aiming while in Multiselection. 
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when using the Thief's Steal ability in multiplayer matches. 
[*]Fixed the smoke visual effects visible after throwing a grenade on a door in an indoor environment. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Spy's Distract action was interrupted when another commando was selected. 
[*]Fixed an issue where aiming sometimes did not work correctly while peeking through windows. 
[*]Fixed an issue where some cutscenes stuttered and were out of sync with audio.  
[*]Fixed some issues with Multiplayer lobby connections.. 
[*]Fixed some additional issues with Multiplayer lobbies and invites.   
[*]Improved the frame rate in multiplayer matches. 
[*]Fixed some disconnection issues in multiplayer matches. 
[*]Player's Gamer Card is now properly interactable in Multiplayer lobbies. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the "Previous Room" and "Next Room" graphical user interface did not work in Multiplayer games.[/list]

notes.title: Commandos 3 – HD Remaster Available Now
notes.content:
[h1]Commandos 3 – HD Remaster Available Now [/h1]
[h2]The HD remaster of the classic tactical strategy title is now available on digital platforms[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39222862/1be12c4c4f65ee5eeaa201a77e1a548855c577cd.png[/img]
[h3]Recruits, stand by.[/h3]
Commandos 3 – HD Remaster will be infiltrating enemy lines starting today. The HD Remaster of the third edition to the genre-defining series is [b]available today with Game Pass on console and PC[/b]. The tactical strategy game is [b]available digitally on Xbox One, Windows PC, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch™ right now!   [/b]

In this revamped edition of Commandos 3, players will have their tactical know-how put to the test as they take history into their own hands. The notorious special forces unit consists of 6 iconic commandos, all experts in their fields and crucial to success: the Green Beret, Sapper, Sniper, Diver, Spy and Thief. Players will have to perfect their strategy as they face the pressure of 12 daring missions across the 3 perilous frontlines of Stalingrad, Central Europe and Normandy, all with reworked 3D models and textures, improved controls and a refined user interface. Keen to rally more recruits? Players can also compete in ‘Deathmatch’ or ‘Collect the Flag’ modes for 2-8 players.  

[b]Commandos 3 – HD Remaster is available digitally from today with Game Pass on console and PC and is out now on Xbox One, Windows PC, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch™[/b]. The title will be available physically as a Commandos Double Pack on 27th October 2022 and is now available for pre-order.  

[h3]Sneak under the barbed wire and check out the trailer below.  [/h3]

[list][*] Remastered in high definition: includes reworked 3D models and textures built from the ground up, improved controls, refined UI and beginner-friendly tutorials and hints 
[*] Lead 6 daredevil commandos: the special units under your command, from the Green Beret, Sapper, Sniper, Diver, Spy and Thief, are experts in their field and crucial to the success of your mission 
[*] Relive iconic WWII campaigns: from training camp to 12 daring missions, experience history across 3 major frontlines including Stalingrad, Central Europe and Normandy
